title: Algiers brass bands: Henry Allen, Atlantic and Pacific, Minetta
summary: He recalls Algiers brass bands heard as a boy of eleven or twelve.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: I'm wondering about the bands across the river. That is like the parades and the brass bands. Like Henry Allen had a band. Did you ever hear Professor Monetta's uncle had a band?

Well, I heard Allen band. I heard his band a lot of times. And they had another band over there. And they were all them fellas. I was about, during that time, and I was about around 11, 12 years old. But I know they had the Atlantic band. They had the Pacific band.
Oh yeah, who had that?

Now, I don't want to say it wrong. I don't know if Allen was the Atlantic or the Pacific, but I believe he was the Atlantic band. I believe Allen had. And there was some more fellas, and I can't call them them. They're all old fellas. All them is D's.
Yeah, we'll go check with some other people down there too.
Yeah, I don't know. I think I know one of them was the Pacific, one was the Atlantic.
Atlantic. I didn't know about the Atlantic.
Yeah, they had the Atlantic band and the Pacific band. And they had them two bands now. They, of course, they're using bands from the Orleans.
Yeah, sure.

Yeah. But they were two brass bands. They used to work all the time from the Orleans to the Algea. They had all the work. They used to do more. They had a lot of art fellas work down there. Parades. Art fellas would parade all the time. That's why Allen learned his son, his son boy, his boy there, how to play trumpet in a parade. He had a parade he played. He had his son right in there with him. Yeah. Yeah.
Did you ever hear that Minetta brass band? I think Professor Minetta's uncle had it.
Yeah, they had a brass band. Do you remember it? Well, that's the brand I'm talking about now. Did he ever tell you the name of the band?
No, I think he called it the Norm. That was his name. Norman, I guess. Norm Minetta brass band. Oh. That might have had another name too.

Well, I small kid, I got their band all right. They had a pretty good band. All them fellas had pretty good good doing them top. See, the people wasn't like this. Nah. The people went for anything. If you just could play a guitar. Oh, yeah. It was all right. But they didn't like that. Nah. Yeah. But they band what they had went over big. Yeah, I know the Minetta band. But I was small.
Yeah, sure.
And also him, he was young himself.
Oh, yeah.
Yeah, he was.
But I think it was his uncle, Professor Minetta's uncle, that really ran the band.
Yeah.

See, Fess is six years older than you. Oh. But his uncle was a good deal older than that. Yeah. I wondered if there was much difference between the music over there. I guess all the same fellas played on each side though.
